description: Source code for the MBLanguage class in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder module, responsible for handling language string loading, merging, and saving functionalities for modules.

classes.name: MBLanguage
classes.description: Handles language file operations such as loading, merging, retrieving, and saving language strings for SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an MBLanguage instance with name, path, label, and key_name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads language strings from defined sources.

methods.name: loadStrings
methods.description: Loads language strings from a specified file into the object.

methods.name: loadAppListStrings
methods.description: Loads application list strings from specified files.

methods.name: generateModStrings
methods.description: Generates module language strings by loading relevant templates and language files.

methods.name: getModStrings
methods.description: Retrieves language strings for a specified language, merging with 'en_us' if available.

methods.name: getAppListStrings
methods.description: Retrieves application list strings for a specified language.

methods.name: generateAppStrings
methods.description: Generates application list strings, optionally from templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current language strings and application list strings to files.

methods.name: getGlobalAppListStringsForMB
methods.description: Ensures dropdown list options are included when creating new dropdown fields.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Copies language files from the current path to a specified new path.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a label into the specified language if available.
